title: The Immemorial Order II Sisters of Darkness
description:
Story

You’ve clocked in for yet another monotonous shift at the warehouse, the scent of tobacco hanging heavily in the air. You glance at the article on your phone: “Shadows over Bricksmore.” The title sparks a flicker of excitement in your otherwise drab existence. “Is it real?” you mutter to yourself, fingers itching to explore the mystery of The Royal Immemorial Order of Ophidia further. Back home you research late into the night, but find little. Just old videos and vague rumors of gatherings deep in the woods. Frustrated but fueled by curiosity, you decide to set off on your own investigation.

Features

- Achievements
- Autosave and load
- Atmospheric environments 
- Jump scares 
- A spooky castle 
- A squeaky Duck 

Gameplay

The Immemorial Order II Sisters of Darkness is primarily an atmospheric first-person walking simulator that doesn't take itself too seriously with comedy and scares.

Mouse and keyboard controls are recommended

You can play through the whole game using a controller, but you will not be able to use any menus or run in the game.
description_short: The Immemorial Order II Sisters of Darkness is primarily a spooky, atmospheric, first-person walking simulator that doesn't take itself too seriously.
